column1: # The texts this tree is measured against, as copies of rokh-docs: the path of
# each in rokh-docs and here, its SHA-256, and the version of the texts it
# belongs to, separated by tabs. A test of rokh/conformance refuses a copy that
# differs from its pin. They change in rokh-docs, by a ruling, and come here
# whole: the copies and this file in one change.
